Main header title 'Home' and compact October 2026 selector. A horizontal typographic summary strip rather than floating cards: 'Bank balance' ₹4,00,000; 'To collect' ₹85,000; 'To pay' ₹20,900. Main section 'Needs attention' with three roomy aligned rows: 'Ravi payment' '₹12,500' amber 'Needs details' button 'Add details'; 'Cloudstack' '₹5,900' gray 'Ready to review' button 'Review'; 'Kumar Legal' '₹15,000' gray 'Ready to review' button 'Review'. Discreet Upload document button in header. Bottom recent transactions table with sensible headings Date, Description, Amount, Status; three rows. No redundant descriptions. Right 300px contextual panel open for Cloudstack: heading 'Cloudstack', invoice CL-2026-10, '₹5,900', account 'Software subscriptions', date '07 Oct', an understated paper invoice preview, 'Prepared for accountant' and one dark green 'Review entry' button. Elegantly balanced useful whitespace, realistic commercially shippable UI, restrained and confident.
